annotations.title: Weekly Sovereign Macro-Prudential & Sanctions Policy Monitor

description: Generates the Weekly Sovereign Macro-Prudential & Sanctions Monitor for Federal Reserve (FOMC / Financial Stability), U.S. Treasury (OFR / OFAC / FinCEN), and SEC DERA policy desks, combining Dual-Track monetary stability indicators (10Y-3M yield curve inversion, FINRA TRACE G-SIB credit spread dislocations, H.8 bank credit impulse) and autonomous x402 sanctions enforcement telemetry. Use when: synthesizing macro-prudential systemic risk briefings, monitoring aggregate sanctions enforcement trends, or evaluating FAR Subpart 13.2 ($9,500 GPC Micro-Purchase) policy data procurement options. Do not use when: screening a specific individual or corporate counterparty against the OFAC SDN list (use screen_ofac_entity instead), or drafting a formal APA 5 U.S.C. § 553 public comment letter for a specific agency rulemaking docket (use synthesize_regulatory_docket instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic intelligence report generator ($1.00 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

include_markdown.description: When true, includes the complete publication-ready Markdown policy brief in markdown_body alongside structured JSON telemetry (default: true).

name: get_sovereign_policy_brief

illicit_finance_track_findings.description: Track 2 Treasury FinCEN / OFAC autonomous x402 sanctions findings.

markdown_body.description: Full formatted Markdown policy brief (present when include_markdown is true).

monetary_track_findings.description: Track 1 Federal Reserve / OFR monetary and credit liquidity findings.

procurement_options.description: FAR Subpart 13.2 ($9,500 GPC Micro-Purchase) and x402 procurement channels.
